title: Original Rules Reconciliation Pass 2
implemented: Referee distraction prevents warnings, pin counts, and accepted submissions.
Playing a Referee Special ends Distract The Referee.
At five or more Warnings, each new warning event triggers a disqualification check at 5% per current Warning.
Original warning values are parsed from card text and applied unless the referee is distracted.
Ric Flair gains 3 Attitude when the opponent receives a Warning.
Custom playbook copy limits now combine cards that explicitly Count As the same move.
Pin scoring is centralized and uses health loss, momentum difference, and a recent finisher modifier.
sourceEvidence: Distract The Referee: distracted referees do not give warnings, count pins, or accept submissions.
Disqualification rule page: once at 5 or more Warnings, chance is 5% per Warning.
Counts As wording on original Trademark and move variants.
stillUnderAudit: The exact internal Pin_Score arithmetic has not yet been recovered from executable code; the centralized formula remains marked provisional.
Individual submission pages can override damage, release, Autocounter cost, or inability to submit and require card-by-card script translation.
Some warning effects use conditional or random values and need dedicated interpreters rather than text parsing.
